settings.default_short_description: A powerful Lal Kitab remedy for reducing Rahu dosha, combining the purity of silver with the divine symbolism of the elephant (Lord Ganesha). Made from 100% solid 999 silver, it attracts positivity, prosperity, and protection when placed in your home or workspace.
settings.tab_1_content:
Silver Elephant is a sacred remedy symbol of strength, intelligence, and graceful abundance.

In Lal Kitab practice, it is kept for prosperity flow, authority support, and obstacle reduction.
settings.tab_2_content:
• Helps neutralize the malefic effects of Rahu , reducing confusion, fear, and sudden obstacles
  • Strengthens Moon (Chandra) energy through silver, bringing emotional balance and mental peace
  • Symbol of Lord Ganesha, aiding in removal of obstacles and attracting wisdom and success
  • Promotes prosperity, stability, and protection in life
  • Creates a positive energy field in home or workplace, balancing negative planetary influences
